description: This file defines the FilterField class, an entity representing filter fields used in report filtering within the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties like id, reportGroup, name, whereClausePart, filterFieldWidget, conditionNo, required, className, and methods for accessing and modifying these properties, leveraging Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping.

classes.name: FilterField
classes.description: Doctrine ORM entity representing a filter field used in reporting with properties for database mapping, including relationships to ReportGroup and SelectedFilterField. Contains getter and setter methods for each property, facilitating ORM operations.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the filter field.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the filter field.

methods.name: setReportGroup
methods.description: Associates this filter field with a ReportGroup entity.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the filter field.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the filter field.

methods.name: getWhereClausePart
methods.description: Returns the SQL WHERE clause part associated with this filter.

methods.name: setWhereClausePart
methods.description: Sets the SQL WHERE clause part for this filter.

methods.name: getFilterFieldWidget
methods.description: Returns the widget type used for this filter field.

methods.name: setFilterFieldWidget
methods.description: Sets the widget type for the filter field.

methods.name: getConditionNo
methods.description: Returns the condition number for this filter.

methods.name: setConditionNo
methods.description: Sets the condition number for this filter.

methods.name: isRequired
methods.description: Checks if the filter field is required.

methods.name: setRequired
methods.description: Sets whether the filter field is required.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Returns the CSS class name associated with the filter.

methods.name: setClassName
methods.description: Sets the CSS class name associated with the filter.
